acceptance_criteria.criterion: No caller constructs .cim or .thb2 paths manually — all path construction goes through IAppPaths.
Both FakeAppPaths compile without errors; all existing tests pass.
dotnet build -c Release reports zero warnings.

summary: Added CoverImagePath(string hash) and ThumbnailFilePath(string hash, long thumbnailId) to IAppPaths interface.
Implemented both methods in AppPaths using Path.Combine(MovieDataDirectory(hash), ...) — cv.cim suffix for cover, {thumbnailId}.thb2 suffix for thumbnails.
Updated FakeAppPaths in VideoIndexer.Tests/Fixtures and VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers to implement the new interface members.
Fixed LiveAppPaths in FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests (an undocumented IAppPaths implementation) which also required the two new methods.
dotnet build -c Release: 0 warnings, 0 errors. All 643 tests (unit + app) pass.

comments.note: FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests.LiveAppPaths (tests/VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests/ExternalTools/FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests.cs) is a third IAppPaths implementation that was not listed in WP-001 scope and is not documented in file-tree.md. Whenever IAppPaths grows, this hidden test double also needs updating. Consider consolidating it with one of the two existing FakeAppPaths, or note it in file-tree.md so it is visible to future agents.

AppPaths.CoverImagePath and ThumbnailFilePath delegate to MovieDataDirectory, which validates the hash via ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace. The two new methods therefore inherit null/empty guard behaviour transitively without repeating it — consistent and intentional, but worth noting for future interface implementors who may not call MovieDataDirectory internally.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified by code inspection and test execution.

AC1 & AC2 (path shapes): AppPaths.CoverImagePath and ThumbnailFilePath delegate to MovieDataDirectory via Path.Combine — return values match the required {MovieDataDirectory(hash)}/cv.cim and {MovieDataDirectory(hash)}/{id}.thb2 shapes exactly.
AC3 (no manual paths): grep over src/ and tests/ confirms .cim and .thb2 strings only appear inside IAppPaths implementations; no caller constructs these paths manually.
AC4 (FakeAppPaths compile): both VideoIndexer.Tests/Fixtures/FakeAppPaths and VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/FakeAppPaths implement the new members and compile cleanly.
AC5 (Release build): dotnet build -c Release reports 0 warnings and 0 errors across all 6 projects.
Regression: 643 tests pass (282 unit + 361 app), 0 failures.

comments.note: No dedicated unit tests exist for AppPaths.CoverImagePath or AppPaths.ThumbnailFilePath. All AC were verified by static code inspection plus the passing build. A future test for AppPaths path shape assertions (e.g. asserting the return value contains 'cv.cim' or '{id}.thb2') would provide regression safety if suffixes ever change.

AppPaths.ThumbnailFilePath does not independently validate thumbnailId (e.g. negative or zero). Input arrives from DB auto-increment IDs so this is acceptable by convention, but worth noting for future implementors.

App.Tests FakeAppPaths uses hardcoded Windows-style paths (C:\FakeAppData\...) which are consistent with the existing fake but would fail cross-platform if the test suite were ever ported to Linux/macOS.

summary: Code review complete — PASS with one Fix-Forward applied.

VideoIndexer.Tests/Fixtures/FakeAppPaths: delegates to MovieDataDirectory correctly — good pattern.

VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/FakeAppPaths: Fix-Forward applied — CoverImagePath and ThumbnailFilePath now delegate to MovieDataDirectory via Path.Combine instead of duplicating the full path inline. Non-behavioral change (identical values on Windows), 643/643 tests still pass.
LiveAppPaths in FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests.cs: correct implementation; flagged as documentation-forward (undocumented third IAppPaths test double).

comments.note: tests/VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/FakeAppPaths.cs — CoverImagePath and ThumbnailFilePath were hardcoding the full path inline (e.g. `$@"C:\FakeAppData\...\{hash}\cv.cim"`), duplicating the MovieDataDirectory base path. Changed both to delegate via Path.Combine(MovieDataDirectory(hash), ...) — consistent with VideoIndexer.Tests/Fixtures/FakeAppPaths pattern and removes the duplication. Non-behavioral on Windows; 643/643 tests pass.

[documentation-forward] FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests.cs contains a private nested class LiveAppPaths that is a third IAppPaths implementation. It is not listed in file-tree.md or constraints.md. Add an entry to file-tree.md noting its existence and purpose (test-local fixture to prevent writes to real %APPDATA%), and add a note to constraints.md warning that all three IAppPaths implementations (FakeAppPaths x2 + LiveAppPaths) must be updated whenever the interface grows.

The null/whitespace guard in AppPaths.CoverImagePath and ThumbnailFilePath is inherited transitively through MovieDataDirectory — intentional and correct. The IAppPaths XML docs for both methods do not mention the ArgumentException behaviour. This is acceptable since the contract docs focus on path shape; the guard is an implementation detail. No action required.
